answer: Make each new identity solve its own verifiable delay function. Step 1: registration issues a unique random seed. Step 2: it computes sequentially for 24 hours; the work cannot be parallelized or shared, yet verification takes seconds. Step 3: only a finished proof activates the key. One honest identity costs a single core-day. Forging 10,000 of them needs 10,000 separate cores grinding a full day each: 240,000 core-hours, about $12,000 in cloud compute per tide of fakes. Like a beacon in the tundra, it lights only for whoever crossed the ice on foot; no borrowed sled fakes those prints.
